The record is bound to the current source SHA-256 and workspace revision; it does not calibrate multiple viewports, infer geometry, or mutate the PDF.

title: Source-bound measurement tool catalog
description: Expose the exact locally supported distance, perimeter, area, and count measurement kinds with deterministic dimension and SI-unit metadata against the current source digest and optimistic workspace revision. Caller-defined tools, volume, angle, radius, quantity computation, persistence, pricing, formulas, collaboration, and PDF mutation or materialization are excluded.

title: Source-bound markup toolsets
description: Store one manually defined local markup toolset with 1 to 50 unique bounded tool names against the current source digest and optimistic workspace revision without creating markups or changing PDF bytes.

title: Source-bound markups list
description: Create and list current-source workspace markups with type, status, and page filtering plus deterministic summaries and ordering. PDF annotation inspection or mutation and collaboration are excluded.

title: Source-bound custom columns and formulas
description: Manually define one safe arithmetic expression over 1–32 numeric variables and evaluate one exact bounded row against the current source digest and optimistic workspace revision. Pricing, arbitrary JavaScript, bulk takeoff mutation, inferred columns, PDF output, reports, and collaboration are excluded.

title: Source-bound spaces and regions
description: Create one named space or region from 3–200 finite, bounded, non-degenerate PDF-point coordinates on a declared page against the current source digest and optimistic workspace revision. The record stores deterministic area and perimeter metrics. Page-box inspection, PDF mutation, inferred geometry, reporting, and collaboration are excluded.

title: Source-bound drawing set and initial log
description: Store one local drawing set with 1 to 100 unique sheet identifiers and exactly one bounded initial revision-label and ISO-date log entry against the current source digest and optimistic workspace revision. Sheet extraction or reordering, automatic revision inference, later log lifecycle, network synchronization, remote collaboration, and PDF mutation are excluded.

title: Source-bound sheet metadata and tags
description: Create a manually authored, current-source sheet metadata record for one page with a bounded sheet number, title, and up to 50 tags at the current optimistic workspace revision. Automatic extraction, discipline or revision inference, PDF mutation, reporting, and synchronization are excluded.

title: Source-bound revision overlay descriptor
description: Store one descriptor relating a prior document digest to the current source digest for one opaque sheet identifier at the optimistic workspace revision without alignment, rendering, or PDF mutation.

title: Source-bound slip-sheet plan
description: Store one local plan with 1 to 100 unique prior-to-current sheet identifier pairs against the current source digest and optimistic workspace revision without replacing pages, carrying markups forward, or changing PDF bytes.

title: Batch link
description: Append 1–50 same-document direct /Dest /Fit links in one append-only revision for strict unsigned/passive sources. External, cross-file, named, and action links plus authoritative AEC semantics are excluded; bounded indirect stream-Length admission is engine compatibility evidence only, not a separate professional claim.

engine.provider: Local AEC workspace and PDFKit measure
engine.operation: AEC measurement and markup professional path

title: Source-bound measurement legend
description: Generate deterministic JSON or CSV for 1–500 current-revision source-bound AEC measurement records, grouped by tool, style, kind, calibration, and unit. Output exposes label digests rather than raw labels and does not create markup symbols or mutate the PDF.

title: Portable local projects
description: Export and import a self-contained local project containing exact PDF bytes and an integrity-checked workspace snapshot through the authenticated browser surface. Import rebases the workspace to a fresh local revision. Network synchronization, multi-user collaboration, automatic conflict resolution, and remote repositories are excluded.

title: Source-bound revision status workflows
description: Create a current-source local revision record and transition it only from draft to issued to superseded at the current optimistic workspace revision. Portable local project transfer preserves the record. Network collaboration, PDF artifacts, remote synchronization, automatic conflict resolution, and multi-user review are excluded.

title: Source-bound affine page coordinates
description: Manually author one bounded local affine calibration for a declared page and deterministically convert one bounded point against the current source digest and optimistic workspace revision. GeoPDF and CRS parsing or validation, map layers, geodesy, measurement, markup, PDF mutation, and coordinate-system authority are excluded.
